info.title: HR Policy Lookup API
info.description: Custom file-metadata lookup tool for Copilot Studio (Pattern C — Dual-Tool Routing). Mirrors the canonical file_metadata_lookup tool definition from honestypugh2/foundry-copilot-search-validate (src/agents/orchestrator_pattern_b.py). Returns metadata fields only — it does NOT call the knowledge base or synthesize an answer.

post.summary: Look up the storage location of an HR policy document
post.description: Look up the storage location, file path, blob URL, and filename for a document in the HR policy knowledge base. Use this tool when the user asks WHERE a document is located, asks for a file path, URL, link, blob storage path, or document location. This performs a direct index search for metadata fields only — it does NOT use the knowledge base. Do NOT use this for content/policy questions.

query.description: The search query to find the document. Include policy number and/or document title (e.g. 'PTO policy 50010', 'Code of Ethics 10000', 'uniform dress code').

200.description: Lookup results — metadata fields only, no backend model synthesis

query.description: The original document-location query submitted to the lookup API.

policy_id.description: The policy number of the highest-ranked matching document, such as 50020.

title.description: The authoritative title of the highest-ranked matching policy document.

blob_url.description: The direct HTTPS URL of the highest-ranked matching policy document. Return this URL verbatim to the user.

expanded_query.description: The normalized query used to search the policy index.

total.description: The number of matching policy documents returned by the lookup.

processing_time_ms.description: The server-side lookup duration in milliseconds.

documents.description: Ranked matching policy documents and their authoritative storage metadata.

policy_number.description: The policy number for this matching document.

parent_title.description: The authoritative policy title for this matching document.

metadata_storage_name.description: The source document filename in storage.

metadata_storage_path.description: The authoritative source storage path for this document.

blob_url.description: The direct HTTPS URL for this matching policy document.

score.description: The Azure AI Search relevance score for this match.
